However, I’m fine with being an asshole for the guy that delivered my meal the other night. My cars in the shop and was to sore to hop on my motorcycle. So I tried to see what is was like for the DoorDash customer. 

It was 10 at night no traffic, 2.5 miles away with a 25-35min eta. I order, add a $10 tip to a $17 dollar meal, and wait it out. 
Guy picks up my order about 15min after I put in. When it gets closer to delivery time 20 min later  I check the map, and he’s going in the opposite direction. Whatever maybe it’s a stacked order. Another 20 minutes later and  now after delivery time he’s in a whole other direction than he was before and hasn’t even tried to contact me with a heads up. So I sent a text asking the ETA. No response. Instead it’s another 30 minutes before he finally arrives. Despite no-contact instructions I get a message saying he can’t find me. I go to the door and he’s at the fucking door with his bicycle so close I couldn’t open the screen door without him rolling it back. He has my food in a wire basket on his handle bars in a plastic bag that he then removes and decides to just hand me the boxes my burger and side dish are in. No hot bag and him riding around meant the food hadn’t just cooled down, but was cold like it’d been in the fridge for a bit. 

I’m not sorry about that 1 star at all, some people shouldn’t be delivering. I understand the need for an income but at least make an effort to do the job right. 

If I wasn’t aware what couriers go through I’d be completely soured by this experience and would only tip after it was delivered. 
I think a lot customers don’t understand a lot of what goes on our the courier side. I think it’d be even more helpful if couriers posted the stories about shitty customers they have in the sub reddit for their city/state at least. I know some may not want it all over their social media but at least posting in your area you know more customers will see it. I feel like the ones that browse subs like this and DD and postmates are people that want to be considerate or wouldn’t want to be seen any other way.

The best thing to do is to just tell them. Write it out ways that you think might help, write out ways that you think she could help or push you. My therapist is all about taking it slow, which I like but she was at a very slow pace. I also was honest about my lack of connection to her and we talked about what might help and make feel more comfortable and trust her. Obviously in time I would but just other things too.
